info.title: Baseball Explorer API
info.description: Read-only historical analytics. Python is authoritative for every number; see docs/NEXTJS_API_CONTRACTS.md.

get.summary: Find players by name (the app's player-picker matching)
One player by exact name; 409 ambiguous_player lists candidates

parameters.name: split
parameters.description: team: split seasons stay separate; combined: one row per season.

parameters.name: teams
parameters.description: Comma list of franchise names, 'American League', 'National League'.

parameters.name: combine
parameters.description: Combine split-team seasons into one row.

parameters.name: min_ab
parameters.description: Minimum AB. Setting it switches qualification to manual.

parameters.name: qualified
parameters.description: Apply the qualified AB to rate-stat rankings (the app's default).

parameters.name: min_{STAT}
parameters.description: Stat minimums, e.g. min_HR=20, min_OPS=0.8 (R AB H 2B 3B HR RBI SB BB BA OBP SLG OPS).

best_season.description: Counting-stat best season, as the page names it.
